detail.title: 4MP 20x WizColor Network PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD4F420DA-HNY 4MP 20x WizColor Network PTZ Camera Key Points • Captures a Large Area and Great Details at the Same Time • High-Quality Imaging with 4MP Resolution • Supports 20x Hybrid Zoom for Better Image Quality at Long Distances • Exceptional Image Quality in Low-Light Environments by WizColor Technology • Expansive Night View With up to 80 m Warm Light Distance for 24/7 Monitoring • Xinghan Large-Scale AI Models: Comprehensive Enhancement of Target Detection, Imaging • Super AI Coding: Ultra-low Storage with Less Image Quality Loss • IP66 & TVS 6000V Protection with Lightning/Surge/Voltage Transient Resistance Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Intelligence Notes: Face detection and perimeter protection cannot be enabled simultaneously.
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire, intrusion, crossing fence, loitering, abandoned object, missing object, fast moving, parking detection, and crowd gathering. Supports the classification alarm of vehicle and human.
General.Face Detection (Full Image): Face detection; snapshot; face snapshot set as face, one-inch photo, or custom; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot and quality priority).
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by sub stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 2560 × 1440@(1–25fps) Sub stream: 704 × 576@(1–25 fps)/704 × 480@(1–25 fps) Third stream: 352 × 288@1 fps/352 × 240@1 fps *The values above are the max frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 32 kbps–6144 kbps H.265: 12 kbps–6144 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Audio Compression: PCM; G.711a; G.711Mu; G.726; MPEG2-Layer2; G.722.1
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; tripwire; intrusion; fast moving; abandoned object; missing object; loitering detection; crowd gathering; parking detection; scene changing; abnormal audio; voltage detection; external alarm; face detection; SMD; security exception
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; PPPoE; SNMP; P2P; Bonjour; Auto Registration
General.Security: Session security;Digest; WSSE; Account lockout; Trusted execution; Generation and importing of X.509 certification; 802.1x; Security logs; Security warning; IP/MAC filtering; HTTPS; Trusted upgrade; syslog; Trusted boot
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile G & Profile T & Profile M); CGI
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (supports max 512 GB); NAS
General.Sound Warning: Offers 3 sound alarms and supports importing custom sound alarms. Sound: 0–100. Play times can be set from 1 to 10. (An external speaker is required.)
General.Heater (Window Heating): Quickly removes water, ice, snow, and mist from the glass to keep images clear.
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –15° to 90°, auto flip 180°
General.Alarm Input: 2 channels in: supports wet contact connection (max load 5 mA 3–5 VDC); supports dry contact connection
General.Alarm Output: 1 channel out: dry contact, max load 1,000 mA 30 VDC/500 mA 50 VAC
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 8.1 W (12 VDC); 12 W (PoE); Max.: 19 W (12 VDC); 21.5 W (PoE) (motor + all lights + heating on); Heating: 1.68 W (12 VDC); 1.7 W (PoE)
General.Protection: IP66; TVS 6000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
General.Anti-corrosion Level: Basic Protection *The products are designed for general use and are applicable even in areas with no specific requirements for anti-corrosion protection.
